readable_companions.local_arc_corroboration: Public InfernoEmbedded u-boot2f5e45fa pmu_clock.c371..390 uses PHY_REG_CLK_PHASE_BASE90040600, pulses p[13]1->0 and p[32]0->1->0. microreset_hypothesis.operation: Maintain MuxSel0, change MicroReset9->1 with readback, preserve stall bit0 throughout; never write0
microreset_hypothesis.public_bit_definitions: ST trusted-firmware csr header: CSR_STALLTOMICRO bit0, CSR_RESETTOMICRO bit3; same d0099 identity independently used by SiMa
microreset_hypothesis.upstream_host_reference: u-boot/u-boot5508406582f6f7120dce0c4b3059819a41788db2 drivers/ram/aspeed/dwc_ddrphy_phyinit_ddr5-3200-nodimm-train2D.c5173..5182 explicitly distinguishes9->1 reset pulse from0 begin firmware execution
microreset_hypothesis.same_generation_context: SiMa post-training host reader uses Micro1, Mux0, clocks3. SiMa cold host stream leaves Micro1 after training before later ZCalReset/Run writes. Neither proves T736 cold ZCal's reset-domain dependencies.
microreset_hypothesis.nxp_retention_limit: imx-sm eec232878ab7dd460f5a8f3767d39dc7e9412efa fsl_ddr.c414..497 does not touch MicroReset; prior reset state cannot be inferred from helper alone
microreset_hypothesis.assessment: Reasonable single-variable reset-dependence experiment with source callbacks and SRAM guards, stronger interface semantics than unnamed companion writes. No evidence yet establishes that micro reset gates ZCal FSM or result latch.

zero_codes.compctrl: Observed2030b=0 matches SiMa static configuration; zero alone is not identified as a disabled calibrator.

zero_codes.result_latch: NXP helper.c338..339 reads20326/327 as saved ZQ codes, but target freshness/validity and companion output-latch strobes remain unproved. Unchanged zeros are ambiguous.

rate_bit4_experiment_review.condition: Root plans only after rawPclkDivRatio observation; currentZCalRate9 and stalledPMU are explicitly frozen preconditions
rate_bit4_experiment_review.interface_basis: SiMa names20303 ZCalRate; publicA733 pmu_clock.c371..390 reads originalp[3], assertsZCalReset1, writes(original&ef)|10, then deassertsreset and pulsesrun. This is a non-program CSR interface fact, not permission to import firmware logic or tables.
rate_bit4_experiment_review.proposed_single_variable_sequence: reset1, rate19, reset0, run1, measured100us, run0, rate9; originalrate9 restored only after every priorstep succeeds. No cleanup writes after error.
rate_bit4_experiment_review.assessment: Sufficient for a bounded SRAM diagnostic of bit4dependence, with readbacks and existing controller/owner/clock guards. Does not establish bit4's name, necessity or cold-calibration completeness.
